correctness.rationale: The proof uses a published exact invariant-base decomposition and verifies that the base homology vanishes in degrees 2k and 2k-1 for k>=2. Natural long exact sequences identify degree 2k with the direct-sum relative homology of the two exceptional simplices. Their stabilizer is the index-two dihedral subgroup with standard action on a 6k-cycle. Signed orbit independence-polynomial calculations give cycle rotation trace 2cos(pi*a/3) and zero reflection trace for all k; induction and rational character theory give the claimed two constituents. Independent standard-library checks cover 336 cycle actions and exact chain-level prism instances. They do not replace the arbitrary-width proof.

value.rationale: The new infinite-family statement determines a nontrivial four-dimensional natural symmetry representation not recoverable from the previously known wedge ranks. Its two irreducible summands have distinct rotation orders and opposite layer parity, with a meaningful rational quotient-homology consequence. It provides a structural boundary case where the invariant base is not contractible but lies above the degree of interest.
